headline: Automatic Data Processing (ADP) Stock Looks Reasonable After Its 44% Five Year Run
summary: Automatic Data Processing stock has delivered a 43.9% return over the past 5 years, yet the current valuation picture is mixed, with an intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model suggesting the shares trade at a discount while the market multiples look closer to fair. Over 5 years, shareholders have seen a 43.9% return, which points to steady value creation over a longer holding period rather than a short term surge.
